### Insights Dropping rows removed only 1.58% of the data, while dropping columns removed 18.18% of the data. Therefore, dropping rows is a better option because it retains more information from the dataset.

```{python}
# 1. Create a Boolean mask using conditional logic

mask = (
    (
        (data['Industry'] == 'Hardware') &
        (
            data['City'].isin(
                ['Beijing', 'San Francisco', 'London']
            )
        )
    )
    |
    (
        (data['Industry'] == 'Artificial intelligence') &
        (data['City'] == 'London')
    )
)

# 2. Apply the mask to the `df_companies` dataframe and assign the results to `df_invest`

df_invest = data[mask]

df_invest
```

```{python}
# Group the data by Country/Region

    .sum()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
)
```
